name: @veda-hq/sarathi
description: Runs a project's Claude Code hooks from one entry per event, with kavach's guards built in, publishes claude.ai pages through a one-off session, carries an agent worktree through its life, and carries the sarathi plugin's agents and working-rules skill.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf lessons && cp -R ../../docs/lessons lessons
scripts.smoke: node dist/bin.js --version && test -z "$(echo {} | bash hooks/worktree-archive.sh)" && node dist/bin.js check --config test/fixture/sarathi.json --settings test/fixture/settings.json && echo {} | bash hooks/format-before-write.sh && bash hooks/action-box.sh < test/fixture/artifact-read.json && (bash hooks/action-box.sh < test/fixture/action-box-bare.json 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 2) && (node dist/bin.js hook PreToolUse --config test/fixture/action-box-sarathi.json < test/fixture/action-box-bare.json >/dev/null 2>&1; test $? -eq 2) && node dist/bin.js hook PreToolUse --config test/fixture/action-box-sarathi.json < test/fixture/action-box-bare.json 2>&1 | grep -q 'sarathi action box: the page publish_version sends has no complete action box' && node dist/bin.js hook PreToolUse --config test/fixture/action-box-sarathi.json < test/fixture/action-box-whole.json && SARATHI_LESSONS_DIR=$(mktemp -d) bash hooks/lessons.sh < test/fixture/pools-failure.json | grep -q 'Address pools exhausted' && PUBLISH_GUARD_MODE=read node dist/page/guard.js < test/fixture/artifact-read.json && (PUBLISH_GUARD_MODE=read node dist/page/guard.js < test/fixture/artifact-publish.json 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 2) && node --input-type=module -e "(await import('./dist/page/page.js')).requireGuard()" && node dist/bin.js page --comments 2>&1 | grep -q 'needs a value' && d=$(mktemp -d) && SARATHI_AUTOFIX_DIR=$d node dist/bin.js hook PostToolUse --config test/fixture/autofix-sarathi.json < test/fixture/autofix-create.json && SARATHI_AUTOFIX_DIR=$d node dist/bin.js autofix list --session smoke | grep -q 'veda-hq/veda#90' && SARATHI_AUTOFIX_DIR=$d node dist/bin.js hook PostToolUse --config test/fixture/autofix-sarathi.json < test/fixture/autofix-wrap-up.json | grep -q '\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"sarathi: Auto-fix is not on.*veda-hq/veda#90' && r=$(mktemp -d) && node --input-type=module -e "(await import('./dist/services/prune.js')).copyRuntime('dist', process.argv[1])" $r && (node $r/services/prune.js bogus 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 1) && node $r/services/prune.js bogus 2>&1 | grep -q 'usage: sarathi services prune' && node $r/services/prune.js run --dry-run --docker /nonexistent/docker --settings test/fixture/prune-settings.json | grep -q '^docker: spawn /nonexistent/docker ENOENT'
scripts.check:run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke
